heatSoakCarryover.method: Consecutive chronological drive pairs; degC shed and above-ambient retained fraction vs soak gap. Newtonian soak tau from ln(resid/init excess) vs gap (recorded-ambient pairs, init excess >3C), slope by Sen's slope -- median of all pairwise (y_j-y_i)/(x_j-x_i) (M242) -- rather than a squared-gap-weighted least-squares slope, so neither a single multi-day parked gap nor a cluster of very-short, noise-dominated gaps can dominate the estimate. tauFitIntercept is the fit's own check of the through-origin assumption (median residual at gap=0); small values support it. M429 (audit F06): the tau interval resamples whole arrival-day clusters (calendar day of the following drive), 4000 draws, seed 42, percentile of the draw slopes mapped by tau = -1/slope; draws with a non-negative slope are counted (tau unbounded), not dropped; earlier releases resampled the pairs i.i.d. M430 (audit F05): soakFitQuality reports the held-out (blocked-day cross-validated) error of the same single-exponential line against persistence, a constant level and empirical gap-bin medians, with the in-sample R2 printed (a negative value means the through-origin line is worse than a free-level mean on the log scale).
